*** Add File: /Users/dhruv2mars/dev/github/portfolio/gauntlet/critics/color-atmosphere-r2.md
+## Verdict
+- piece: color-atmosphere
+- round: r2
+- winner: bar
+- biggest_gap: Dark surface gains grid and warm depth, but cyan mark/chrome contradict the amber contract and the light capture is an empty field, so atmosphere is not a reliable system.
+- next_build_instruction: Make one signal own every theme: retint mark, active nav, icon strokes, focus states, and any activity ramp to the amber family; remove residual cyan. Fix light-theme rendering so the same complete identity hero is visible, then give both modes one deliberate structural signature (tight frame, ruled field, or owned watermark) with grain that survives grayscale. Keep dashboard/telemetry below fold, quiet nav chrome, and recapture desktop plus mobile before judging again.
+- must_pass_touched: 1 pass; 2 pass; 3 pass; 5 fail; 8 pass; 12 pass
+- evidence_paths:
+  - gauntlet/pieces/color-atmosphere/r2/dark-home-desktop.png
+  - gauntlet/pieces/color-atmosphere/r2/light-home-desktop.png
+  - gauntlet/pieces/color-atmosphere/r2/dark-home-mobile.png
